purpose: Give the two reader-visible synthesis previews small, copyable Codex preparation contexts without restoring a gated studio, oral defense, project, Core advance, or portal-side record write.

packages.title: M25 evidence-synthesis orientation
packages.summary: Use this brief conversation to locate one missing or conflicting evidence receipt before treating an intelligent-feature claim as a decision.

allowedArtifact.label: Gate card
allowedArtifact.instruction: Name one proposed claim, its transparent baseline and owner, one needed or missing M27–M36 receipt, the current DEFER decision, and one future-M26 question.
allowedArtifact.boundary: No dossier, project, handoff, unlock, or completion claim belongs in this preview card.

packages.teachingAssistantClarificationPrompt: Start the M25 evidence-synthesis preview. This is a preview conversation—not an oral defense, project review, capstone, grade, release decision, or Core-completion claim. Help me make one claim boundary explicit: ask for the baseline, decision owner, and one missing or conflicting M27–M36 receipt. If the designated chat offers GPT Live High, use it; keep equations, code, and a simple claim trace visible in chat as an accessible whiteboard, with prose or ASCII fallback. End with only the PREVIEW ONLY gate card and one future-M26 question. Do not manufacture a dossier, a handoff, an unlock, or evidence that I have not supplied.
packages.studyPartnerPrompt: Start the M25 evidence-synthesis preview rehearsal. This is a preview conversation—not an oral defense or a claim that M25 is complete. Use the visible chat as a whiteboard: retrieve one upstream receipt, trace one assumption to the proposed intelligent-feature claim, then change one premise and ask what must be deferred. When the designated chat offers GPT Live High, use it; render any equations or code visibly and give a prose or ASCII fallback. Keep the result to the PREVIEW ONLY gate card and one future-M26 question; do not create a dossier, project, handoff, unlock, or completion record.

futureForwardContext.label: Future map: M26 capstone reasoning
futureForwardContext.boundary: Module 26 is a future map for the question only, not a handoff or unlock.

notionEvidencePacket.title: M25 preview gate-card packet
notionEvidencePacket.conditions: Only in the designated configured Teaching Assistant or Study Partner chat, after the learner says records on, the session is substantive, and neither pause records nor off-record applies; at most one concise approved summary may be saved.
notionEvidencePacket.boundary: The portal performs no Notion write and must not claim one succeeded without direct evidence. Exclude raw voice recordings and full transcripts.

packages.title: M26 pre-capstone architecture rehearsal
packages.summary: Use this brief rehearsal to state the boundary of one future delivery claim and identify the next falsifier before any capstone decision exists.

allowedArtifact.label: Framing card
allowedArtifact.instruction: Name one claim and non-goal, its owner and source/test anchor, one architecture trace and failure boundary, one missing M27–M36 receipt, and the next falsifier or specialization question.
allowedArtifact.boundary: No release decision, dossier, project, studio, or completion claim belongs in this rehearsal card.
